placements.title: New-hire onboarding runs through one mandated, current checklist
placements.frame: What establishes this checklist (or its successor) as the operative onboarding standard, and what did it supersede or get superseded by?
placements.why: src-1 states the Pallasine checklist as a universal, unnegotiated onboarding mandate naming its three components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) — a subject future onboarding envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-2 is a fact (it replaced the old wiki page last quarter) that evidences this leaf's theme of institutional standing rather than standing as its own leaf — per the narrative grain test it joins the supporting segments of the theme it corroborates. No existing narrative structure was supplied (graph is empty), so nothing could be reused; minted fresh under the newly-minted Organization strata as the closest fit.
